title: UR5e · coordinated tape · link poses per situation for the meshed 3D robot (sim, FK)
source: pid-tuning/robot.json: situations target, factory, tuned. pidtuna-website site/public/data (last changed at c02e786), read 2026-10-26: ur5e.json tapes[coordinated]; FK by MuJoCo 3.17.0 on ~/pidtuna/src/pidtuna/models/ur5e_bare.xml (pidtuna f93cf9c), whose body poses equal Menagerie ur5e.xml's within 0e+00 over 50 random poses. t.note: Seconds from the target's start; every 0.04 s (25 Hz) of the 100 Hz replay, each row the replay's own sample.

situation.note: target or one of pidtuna's controller rungs (sim; the analytic rung is left out of the 3D card).

px.note: Tool site `tool` world x: MuJoCo forward kinematics of the replayed joint angles (sim), model ur5e_bare.xml. Rounded to 1 µm.

py.note: Tool site world y, as px.

pz.note: Tool site world z (up), as px.
